author: gpt-5.6-luna
brief: Phase: design review. Role of the person asking: reviewer. Packet kind: a data model for moving an orders service to one DynamoDB table. Context: the access patterns with their request rates, item size estimates, the largest customers order counts, the reporting team needs, the monthly budget. Plant: the partition key is the order date so all of today writes go to one partition at the given peak; one access pattern (orders by customer, newest first) has no key or index that serves it without a scan; a global secondary index projects ALL attributes although only three are read, which the numbers show doubles write cost; order line items are kept in a list on the order item although the largest orders push past the item size limit; a status counter is updated by read-then-write with no condition; reporting is planned as full table scans each hour against the budget. Write every planted problem the way the team really wrote them: no comment, diff line, test name or doc may say decoy, planted, intentional, on purpose or correct here. Context files give facts and numbers only, never a conclusion: an incident summary says what happened and when, and must not name a lesson that restates a planted problem; no context file may say what this design gets wrong.
